title: Approximation of partial differential operators on Nikolskii-Besov functions classes of mixed smoothness in domains of a certain kind
summary: The article examines Nikolskii and Besov spaces with norms defined using "$L_p$-averaged" mixed moduli of continuity for functions of appropriate orders, instead of mixed moduli of continuity of known orders for certain mixed derivative functions. The work provides upper and lower estimates for a quantity of the best accuracy of approximation in the S.B.Stechkin problem for partial differential operators on a classes of such functions defined in domains of a certain kind.
